E03: budget-matched (545 groups at 25%) comparison of ts_online against the label-free agreement threshold, which has no information advantage. D = -0.172, CI [-0.230, -0.142], favoring the fixed rule, so claim 2 is not supported. L5a and L5c agree. Claim 3: E04 (judge proxy, 0.5B) has AUC gain +0.0001 and neighbor ratio 1.00; L7b (4B judge) has gain -0.0056 and ratio 1.00. Both are non-E01, on a different proxy, and below 0.05 and 1.5, so claim 3 is killed. W2 is false because the label-free comparison controlled the confound. W3 is false because the ledger does not hold claim 3 as supported.
